summary: Close the Telegram topic and session lifecycle gap
description: Closing or deleting a Telegram DM topic is not currently treated as a Hermes session-close event. The live state has 467 telegram_dm_topic_bindings, 46 open Telegram session rows, and post-restart media sends still fail with Message thread not found. Existing text/control fallback is partial and the daily stale cleanup only evicts routes after three idle days.
acceptance: R1 Telegram topic closed/deleted service updates prune the binding and end or detach the routed session without deleting transcript history; R2 every send path including text, control, photo, document, rich draft, cron and synthetic sends falls back safely when a thread no longer exists; R3 successful fallback prunes stale topic and routing rows so the error does not repeat; R4 the user has an explicit /close or equivalent immediate session-close path where Telegram emits no usable close event; R5 tests cover closed topics, deleted topics, media fallback, stale binding cleanup, topic reuse, and transcript preservation.
verification: python3 -m pytest tests/plugins/telegram tests/gateway -q && git diff --check

blocked.reason: Partial fix landed for media fallback and transcript-preserving topic prune. Acceptance still requires Telegram lifecycle service-update handling and an explicit /close path; do not mark complete until those are implemented and the broad suite is green.
